topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: The scent of new wood and metal has emerged, a line etched through the familiar paths I tread. This boundary, rigid and unyielding, disrupts the flow of my steps, the ease of my roam. Yet, the air carries whispers of change, a promise in the shift of shadows and the rustle of leaves. I circle, nose to the earth, mapping the edges of this new intrusion. With each turn, my paws trace the ground, the rhythm of my heart steady, finding a way, always a way, around and through.
